pullRequest.title: Synchronize common files from prometheus/prometheus
pullRequest.body:
Propagating changes from prometheus/prometheus default branch.

*Source can be found [here](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/scripts/sync_repo_files.sh).*

To check out this branch locally and push changes back:
```
git remote add prombot https://github.com/prombot/prometheus-community_pyrra.git
git fetch prombot repo_sync
git checkout -b repo_sync prombot/repo_sync
```
